description: This file defines a base test class for prplMesh testing, including utility methods for network topology, log checking, CMDU verification, SSID configuration, and device management within a testing framework.

classes.name: PrplMeshBaseTest
classes.description: A base test class for prplMesh, containing various utility methods for network testing, device control, and validation.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class and loads tlv data if not already loaded.

methods.name: startMarker(self)
methods.description: Prepares the network topology before starting a test, including clearing SSID configs and checkpointing device states.

methods.name: get_tvls(self)
methods.description: Loads TLV definitions from YAML files into the ieee1905 dictionary.

methods.name: bool check_log(self, entity_or_radio: Union[env.ALEntity, env.Radio], regex: str, start_line: int = 0, timeout: float = 0.6, fail_on_mismatch: bool = True)
methods.description: Verifies the presence of a regex in device logs within a timeout.

methods.name: bool prplmesh_status_check(self, entity_or_radio: Union[env.ALEntity, env.Radio])
methods.description: Checks prplMesh status via a command; returns True if operational.

methods.name: [sniffer.Packet] check_cmdu( self, msg: str, match_function: Callable[[sniffer.Packet], bool] )
methods.description: Verifies that a CMDU matching a condition was captured in the sniffer.

methods.name: [sniffer.Packet] check_cmdu_type( self, msg: str, msg_type: int, eth_src: str, eth_dst: str = None, mid: int = None )
methods.description: Checks for a CMDU with specific type, source, destination, and MID.

methods.name: sniffer.Packet check_cmdu_type_single( self, msg: str, msg_type: int, eth_src: str, eth_dst: str = None, mid: int = None )
methods.description: Checks for a single CMDU with specific parameters.

methods.name: NoReturn check_no_cmdu_type( self, msg: str, msg_type: int, eth_src: str, eth_dst: str = None )
methods.description: Ensures no CMDU with specific type and source exists.

methods.name: [sniffer.Tlv] check_cmdu_has_tlvs( self, packet: sniffer.Packet, tlv_type: int )
methods.description: Verifies that a packet contains at least one TLV of a specified type.

methods.name: sniffer.Tlv check_cmdu_has_tlv_single( self, packet: Union[sniffer.Packet, None], tlv_type: int )
methods.description: Verifies that exactly one TLV of a specified type is present in a packet.

methods.name: NoReturn check_cmdu_has_tlvs_exact( self, packet: Union[sniffer.Packet, None], tlvs: [sniffer.Tlv] )
methods.description: Checks that a CMDU has exactly the specified TLVs.

methods.name: NoReturn check_cmdu_contains_tlvs( self, packet: Union[sniffer.Packet, None], tlvs: [sniffer.Tlv] )
methods.description: Ensures a CMDU contains all specified TLVs.

methods.name: None checkpoint(self)
methods.description: Captures the current device and sniffer state for subsequent comparisons.

methods.name: fail(self, msg: str)
methods.description: Raises an exception with a formatted error message.

methods.name: NoReturn safe_check_obj_attribute(self, obj: object, attrib_name: str, expected_val: Any, fail_str: str)
methods.description: Checks object attribute value against expected, failing if attribute missing or mismatched.

methods.name: base_test_client_capability_query(self, sta: env.Station)
methods.description: Performs a client capability query and verifies the resulting CMDUs.

methods.name: env.ALEntity get_device_by_name(self, device_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a device object by its name from the device list.

methods.name: bool check_topology_notification(self, eth_src: str, neighbors: list, sta: env.Station, event: env.StationEvent, bssid: str)
methods.description: Validates topology change notifications including association event TLVs.

methods.name: Dict[str,connmap.MapDevice] get_topology(self)
methods.description: Retrieves network topology information via the northbound API.

methods.name: configure_ssids_clear(self)
methods.description: Removes all existing SSID access points from the controller.

methods.name: wait_ubus_object(self, path: str, timeout: int = 10)
methods.description: Waits for a specific ubus object to appear within a timeout.

methods.name: wait_radios_enabled(self, timeout: int = 10)
methods.description: Waits until all radios are enabled or timeout occurs.

methods.name: configure_passphrase(self, ssid: str = 'Dummy_ssid', vap_passphrase: str = 'prplmesh_pass')
methods.description: Configures WiFi passphrase on the controller access points.

methods.name: str configure_ssid(self, ssid: str, multi_ap_mode: str = "Fronthaul", bands: Dict = None)
methods.description: Creates or modifies an SSID access point configuration.

methods.name: configure_ssids(self, ssids: [str], clear_old: bool = True)
methods.description: Configures multiple SSIDs on all devices, optionally clearing previous configs.

methods.name: assertEqual(self, path: str, name: str, expected: str)
methods.description: Checks a parameter value against an expected value.

methods.name: send_and_check_policy_config_metric_reporting(self, controller, agent, include_sta_traffic_stats=True, include_sta_link_metrics=True)
methods.description: Sends and verifies policy configuration related to metrics reporting.

methods.name: device_reset_default(self)
methods.description: Resets device to default configuration.

methods.name: device_reset_then_set_config(self)
methods.description: Resets device and re-applies default configuration.

methods.name: teardown_class(cls)
methods.description: Cleans up environment post-test, stops sniffer, and disconnects devices.

methods.name: bool filter_mcast_notifications(mcast)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: assertEqual
ctags.pattern: /^    def assertEqual(self, path: str, name: str, expected: str):$/
ctags.signature: (self, path: str, name: str, expected: str)

ctags.name: check_cmdu
ctags.signature: ( self, msg: str, match_function: Callable[[sniffer.Packet], bool] )

ctags.signature: ( self, packet: Union[sniffer.Packet, None], tlv_type: int )

ctags.name: check_cmdu_type
ctags.signature: ( self, msg: str, msg_type: int, eth_src: str, eth_dst: str = None, mid: int = None )

ctags.name: check_cmdu_type_single
ctags.signature: ( self, msg: str, msg_type: int, eth_src: str, eth_dst: str = None, mid: int = None )

ctags.name: check_no_cmdu_type
ctags.signature: ( self, msg: str, msg_type: int, eth_src: str, eth_dst: str = None )

ctags.name: check_topology_notification
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_topology_notification(self, eth_src: str, neighbors: list,$/
ctags.signature: (self, eth_src: str, neighbors: list, sta: env.Station, event: env.StationEvent, bssid: str)

ctags.name: configure_ssid
ctags.pattern: /^    def configure_ssid(self, ssid: str, multi_ap_mode: str = "Fronthaul",$/
ctags.signature: (self, ssid: str, multi_ap_mode: str = "Fronthaul", bands: Dict = None)

ctags.name: configure_ssids
ctags.pattern: /^    def configure_ssids(self, ssids: [str], clear_old: bool = True):$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def safe_check_obj_attribute(self, obj: object, attrib_name: str,$/
